responsibles.title: Network leads
responsibles.lead: Network administration reviews appeals, builds the teams and appoints the leads; network moderation reads and decides the whole queue. Both read the pilot dashboard. Every appointment, change and removal is reasoned and recorded in the engine's decision log; it applies from the person's next action.
responsibles.inactive: Dormant role: this person's membership is pending or suspended.
responsibles.more: Other leads exist; only the first ones are shown.
responsibles.changeBody: {{name}} will move from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}” from their next action. The change is reasoned and recorded in the engine's decision log.
responsibles.removeBody: {{name}} stays a member of the network, without the “{{role}}” role, from their next action. The removal is reasoned and recorded in the engine's decision log.
responsibles.selfWarning: This is your own role: you will lose its rights with this action.
responsibles.appointLead: Only an active network member, with at least “declared” status, can receive a role; no membership is created. The network always keeps at least one active administrator.
responsibles.handle: Public handle of the person to appoint
responsibles.removed: {{name}} is no longer a network lead.
responsibles.unchanged: {{name}} already has this role: nothing changed.

errors.moderation_desk_last_admin: The network always keeps at least one active administrator: appoint another one before this removal.
errors.moderation_desk_role_refused: This action did not go through: only network administration gives or removes a role, and a role can only be given to an active network member with at least “declared” status.
